overview: 1945 List of Papers (1940-44) indexes Japan's control of China's silk markets, Italian purchasing for Germany, American Silk Spinning's supply search, frozen Japanese credits, barter proposals, military needs, Treasury licensing, a Desvernine-Mitsui inquiry, and Swiss reporting on cocoon production.

subfiles.title: List of Papers on the Silk Industry in Japan
subfiles.about: An administrative index summarizes diplomatic, commercial, financial, and legal records concerning Japanese raw and waste silk between 1940 and the wartime period.
subfiles.summary: List indexes Yokohama/Shanghai/Hong Kong/Canton reports on Japanese silk-market control and suspected Italian purchasing for Germany, American Silk Spinning's inquiries, frozen-credit effects, barter proposals, Treasury licenses, a Justice inquiry into Desvernine's Mitsui representation, and Swiss reporting on cocoon production.

interest: Tracks wartime Japanese silk trade in occupied China, Axis purchasing, U.S. sanctions, and a Mitsui barter legal inquiry.
